cta.title: Ready for a safe and natural smile?
cta.description: Schedule a consultation and get a personalized treatment plan with the support of the DENTALHOLIST team.

faq.title: Answers before your first visit
faq.description: Everything you need to know before coming to our practice.
faq.q1: Can I book an appointment outside working hours?
faq.a1: You can fill in the online form 24/7, and you will receive appointment confirmation as soon as the team processes your request.
faq.q2: How far in advance does the appointment reminder arrive?
faq.a2: The reminder arrives by email 24 hours before the confirmed appointment.
faq.a3: Yes, the initial consultation allows us to create a precise and individual treatment plan.
faq.q4: Is there a payment plan for larger treatments?
faq.a4: For more complex treatments we offer a phased plan and transparent cost estimate.

leadDoctor.name: Dr. Ana Jovanović

testimonials.t1Content: For the first time I felt that dentistry can be a completely calm and premium experience. Everything is clear, professional and stress-free.

testimonials.t3Content: From the first contact to the follow-up everything was organised impeccably. The team is expert, attentive and completely dedicated to the patient.

hero.teamBadgeDescription: with international education and premium protocols

values.title: Principles we work by
values.description: Every aspect of the DENTALHOLIST approach is shaped by the values we have nurtured from day one.
values.value1Description: Every procedure is performed with the highest degree of care and precision, using the most modern equipment and techniques.
values.value2Description: We build long-term relationships with patients based on open communication, honesty and consistency.
values.value3Description: We continuously follow the latest advances in dentistry to provide treatments that are effective and painless.
values.value4Description: Every patient is unique. We adapt our approach to individual needs and care about the overall experience.

timeline.title: A journey of growth and trust
timeline.description: From humble beginnings to a team of 7 specialists, our journey has been defined by every smile we have shaped.
timeline.milestone1Description: DENTALHOLIST opens its doors with a clear vision — to provide dental care that combines expertise, attention and modern technology.
timeline.milestone2Description: The practice grows — the first specialists join us and digital X-ray diagnostics are introduced. The team now counts 4 dentists.
timeline.milestone3Description: We receive national recognition for the quality of services in the field of implantology and aesthetic dentistry.
timeline.milestone4Description: We introduce 3D scanning, CAD/CAM technology for making crowns and complete digital appointment booking.
timeline.milestone5Description: We celebrate 15 years of work with a team of 7 specialists and more than 10,000 satisfied patients.
